entries.title: A custom API that refuses a model's check says why
entries.body: When a server refuses a model's test on Save, such as asking for a setting in its console, the form now says the server refused and shows a short excerpt of its own reason, instead of a server error and advice to try again. The line under it no longer asks you to fix a marked field when none is marked.

picture.alt: The Add a custom API form after Save: above Save, the server refused the request and its reason quoted, then Not saved and Save paused without checking
